description: This PHP source file defines the PurgeDao class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin. It provides database access methods related to employee data purging, including checking if an employee is purgeable and extracting data based on employee numbers.

classes.name: PurgeDao
classes.description: A data access object for performing purge-related database operations pertaining to employees within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: isEmployeePurgeable
methods.description: Checks if an employee with a given employee number is eligible for purging by verifying the presence of a termination record and ensuring it has not been already purged.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves data related to a specific employee number from a specified table, optionally joining related entities based on provided match criteria.
